name: Bikky
description:
Bikky is a customer data platform for restaurants. It unifies point-of-sale, online ordering, and loyalty data into per-guest profiles and analytics, so a restaurant group can see who its guests are, what they order, and how that changes over time.

This connector gives a Bikky customer read-only access to their own data from Claude. Ask in plain language — "what were my top ten menu items by revenue last month", "how many first-time guests came back in Q2", "which location had the biggest drop in average check" — and Claude answers against that business's own orders, guests, menu, location, and segment data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bikky to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bikky to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bikky.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bikky MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bikky provides these MCP tools: describe_business_data, list_businesses, plan_analysis, query_data, and search_business_terms.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bikky?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bikky in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Bikky requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bikky is developed by Bikky. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
